# JIT M4-4 Control/Calls In-Progress Evidence

Date: 2026-07-03

Scope: `bd-h4oh.5` / `M4-4` implemented-subset evidence. This is not M4-4 closure.

## Landed Subset

- Lowered `Jump` and `Branch` terminators for precomputed Boolean conditions.
- Added `Bool`, `Byte`, `Integer`, `LongLong`, `Currency`, `Single`, `Double`, and `Date` slot load/store support for the current compiled subset.
- Added numeric comparison/truthiness lowering for `Long`/`Integer` control-flow shapes, plus `LongLong` comparison and truthiness lowering for conditional control-flow shapes. A source-level mixed fixed-integer comparison row now ratchets the existing i64/i32 compare lane selection for LongLong/Long and Integer/Byte Boolean control-flow composition.
- Added same-type `Currency` comparison and truthiness lowering for conditional control-flow shapes using the scaled `i64` lane, with a guard that keeps mixed Currency/non-Currency comparison outside the current compiled subset.
- Added same-type finite `Single`, `Double`, and `Date` comparison/truthiness lowering for conditional control-flow shapes, with mixed floating/Date lanes and NaN-edge parity left outside the current compiled subset.
- Added direct OxIR checked `Single`/`Double` add/sub/mul lowering for exact typed lanes. Source-level `Single` add/sub/mul assignment shapes now ratchet through the direct `f32` lane; source-level `Double` add/sub/mul and `Date` serial-add assignment shapes run through a narrow `Widening`/`Variant` arithmetic helper lane plus numeric Variant-to-scalar coercion.
- Added helper-mediated OxIR `Div` and `Pow` lowering through the shared `rt_arith_v` Variant arithmetic helper, writing the resulting `Double` payload back to typed Double slots. Source-level `Double` `/` and `^` rows are now promoted, while mixed/string/object and broader `/`/`^` shapes remain outside this slice.
- Added direct OxIR `Logical` and `Not` lowering for `Bool`, `Long`, `Integer`, and `LongLong` operands, with unit coverage for Boolean control-flow and numeric bitwise shapes.
- Narrowed source-level logical-expression typing so Boolean pairs produce `Bool` temps and fixed integer pairs produce typed numeric temps instead of unconditional `Variant` temps. Added source-level vm3-vs-JIT ratchet rows for Boolean logical/not control flow, Long and mixed Byte/Integer fixed-integer bitwise logical expressions, LongLong bitwise `And`/`Or`/`Eqv`/`Not` expressions over LongLong operands, and mixed fixed-integer LongLong logical expressions.
- Added checked `LongLong` add/sub/mul lowering through shared `rt-abi` i64 shims, with overflow seating through the same Err surface as `Long`.
- Added checked `Long`/`LongLong` integer-division and remainder lowering through shared `rt-abi` shims, including divide-by-zero/error seating through the same Err surface. Source-level ratchet coverage now promotes `Long` and `LongLong` `\`/`Mod` rows, and direct JIT unit coverage proves both quotient/remainder slot-write lanes; broader division and non-Long/LongLong remainder lanes remain outside this slice.
- Added checked `Integer` add/sub/mul lowering through shared `rt-abi` i16-narrowing shims, with source-level arithmetic and overflow rows. Added checked `Byte` source arithmetic/overflow coverage by letting the Integer-promoted source expression path feed checked Byte narrowing at assignment/coercion time, while retaining direct OxIR coverage for the checked Byte helper lane.
- Added checked `Currency` add/sub/mul lowering through shared `rt-abi` Currency shims, preserving scaled Currency tags on slot writes and seating overflow through the same Err surface.
- Added checked unary `Neg` lowering for direct OxIR `Long`/`Integer`/`Byte`/`LongLong`/`Currency`/`Single`/`Double` destinations. Integer/Currency lanes reuse the existing checked subtract slot helpers with zero lhs; floating lanes lower directly with `fneg`. Source-level ratchet coverage now promotes `Long`, `LongLong`, `Currency`, `Single`, and `Double` negation rows; the source-level `Double` row uses the helper-mediated `Variant` negation lane described below.
- Added narrow same-type `Long`/`LongLong`/`Currency`/`Single`/`Double`/`Date`/`Byte`/`Integer`/`Boolean` numeric coercion lowering needed by the current scalar declaration/call subset. Boolean operand lowering also accepts binder-materialized integer constants as false/non-false values for the promoted Optional Boolean omitted-default and source-level Boolean numeric assignment rows.
- Added helper-mediated static `CallProc` support for zero-arg calls and `Long`/`LongLong`/`Currency`/`Single`/`Double`/`Date`/`Byte`/`Integer`/`Bool` ByVal scalar arguments, plus exact ByRef scalar arguments including `Currency`, `Single`, `Double`, and `Date`, exact `String` ByVal/ByRef arguments in the promoted source rows including a mixed ByRef/ByVal String call, and exact ByRef `Variant` aliases, covering mixed ByRef/ByVal shapes inside the current stack-descriptor helper ABI. Win64 `LongPtr` source ByVal/return shapes are ratcheted where lowering maps them to the existing LongLong lane. Floating and Date ByVal values use an explicit raw-bit packing shim into the existing `i64` descriptor value lane. The descriptor path now also carries `Variant` ByVal operands and the `MISSING_ARG` sentinel for omitted Optional ByVal `Variant` parameters; source-level ratchet coverage includes folded Optional Variant defaults, omitted Optional Variant call shapes, and binder-materialized Optional `Bool`/`Byte`/`Integer`/`Long`/`LongLong`/`Currency`/`Single`/`Double`/`Date` default/no-default ByVal call shapes.
- Added a narrow helper-mediated `Variant` slot assignment and `Box` path over the existing Variant operand descriptors. The helper clones the source before mutating the destination, supports verifier-valid `Empty` initialization, representation-preserving Variant place copies, and scalar-to-Variant `Box` payloads for the current descriptor subset. This enables source-level Variant assignment, Variant function return bodies, and exact ByRef Variant copy-out in the current scalar-plus-Variant call subset.
- Added direct OxIR checked exact-tag `Unbox` helper coverage for current scalar/`Variant`/`ProcRef` slot targets. Checked mismatches seat error 13 through the shared Err surface; this is direct helper coverage only, not a new source-level ratchet row.
- Added direct OxIR `VariantChanged` lowering through a descriptor-backed Bool-slot helper. The helper clones both operands before writing the destination and reuses the shared `variant_changed` comparison used by VM3 compound ByRef copy-out; this is direct helper coverage only, not a new source-level ratchet row.
- Added helper-mediated `Variant` `Logical`, `Not`, and `Truthy` lowering through shared `rt_logical_v` / `rt_not_v` / `rt_truthy_v` shims. The JIT descriptor helpers clone operands before destination mutation and preserve shared `Null` three-valued logical/truthiness plus numeric Variant logical semantics for the promoted source-level rows.
- Added helper-mediated `Variant` `Compare` lowering through shared `rt_compare_v`, including raw compare-op and string-compare-mode ABI mappings. The promoted source-level rows prove `Null` comparison results remain `Null` before branch truthiness reduces them to false, and numeric Variant/Double comparison takes the shared evaluator path.
- Added helper-mediated `Variant` `Arith` source coverage for explicit Variant destinations through the existing `rt_arith_v` descriptor helper, including `Null` propagation and mixed Variant/Double addition. This is the same shared helper path already used by source-level `Double` Widening arithmetic, now ratcheted for direct Variant result slots.
- Added helper-mediated `Variant` `Neg` lowering through shared `rt_neg_v`. The descriptor helper clones the source before destination mutation and lets the shared evaluator own Widening negation semantics for source-level `Double` unary negation and an explicit `Variant` payload negation row.
- Added shared numeric-coercion ABI targets for helper-mediated `Variant` coercion to current scalar targets, promoting source-level `Variant`-to-`Byte`/`Integer`/`Long`/`LongLong`/`Single`/`Double`/`Currency`/`Date` assignment rows plus the existing `Variant`-to-Boolean assignment/control-flow row without duplicating scalar coercion semantics in the JIT.

The activation shims preserve caller/callee handler policy across calls, and the current Linux slice only claims narrow Resume Next fault-pad routing for bare constant `Err.Raise` plus `Err.Number`; label handlers, `Resume`/`Resume Next` terminators, and GoSub lowering remain outside this row.

## Linux Implementation Boundary

This initial JIT implementation round runs on Linux without PowerShell or Excel/VBA
available. PowerShell-backed formal lanes are tracked as non-blocking environment
debt. Any real Excel/VBA oracle work is deferred to a post-implementation Windows
round with Excel available and must not be treated as an in-cycle Linux blocker.
The deferred Windows/Excel oracle obligation is tracked as `ODG-050` in
`docs/evidence/conformance/DEFERRED_ORACLE_GATES.csv`.

`pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-formal.ps1 -Quiet -NoArtifacts`
and the `powershell` equivalent both failed with `command not found`. The formal lane remains
non-blocking under the current ladder policy and is tracked in
`docs/evidence/formal/EXTENDED_TODO.md` as `FTODO-M4-4-001`.

- Rechecked ByRef aliasing after adding one-level support and found nested ByRef forwarding was not resolved. Fixed by resolving aliases to their ultimate caller/global/temp target and added `calls/nested_byref_long`.
- Rechecked call-shape validation and tightened ByVal lowering so a ByRef/variadic callee parameter cannot enter the ByVal static subset.
- Rechecked stack-guard testing and avoided an unsafe real 50,000-level native-recursion test until the big-stack/non-recursive execution design is implemented.
- Rechecked function call expression typing and found direct VBA function calls were forced through Variant temps. Fixed the OxIR direct-project return type table and added `calls/function_return_long`.
- Rechecked activation entry ordering and moved activation entry after runtime argument/frame validation so malformed helper calls cannot return without restoring caller error policy.

- Rechecked ByRef descriptor setup and now verifies the caller alias slot resolves before the callee is entered, so malformed helper calls cannot install a dangling alias that only faults if the callee happens to touch it.
